create_obstacle: create an Obstacle instance with name, duration, shape, mass, size, position, orientation, velocity, and angular velocity
launch_obstacle: launch an obstacle into the physics simulation by creating a collision shape and multi-body in PyBullet
throw_obstacles: throw multiple obstacles toward a target position with randomized directions, velocities, and orientations
update_obstacles: update all obstacles by decrementing duration, removing expired ones, and syncing position and velocity state
render_obstacles: render all obstacles with OpenGL using fade-out alpha based on remaining duration
